name: Level 600

name: Level 700
description: Reach Level 700. Your journey doesn't end here, keep on pushing no matter what it takes. AFK farming, grinding special rounds, or exploiting. Actually, don't exploit, or else you're BANNED. Just, like, get some help if that happens, cause that's a lot of time lost.

name: Level 800
description: Reach Level 800. You're in the big leagues now, kiddo. You know what? You're like a household name, I've been hearing some friends yap about how cool you were and how much time you spent on Evade. Congratulations. Feel free to put this remarkable rank on your resumé / CV. Your employer will definitely recognize this accomplishment. Though, if you have reached this rank, I'm sure you don't have a full-time job to worry about lol

name: Level 900
description: Reach Level 900. Almost there, man. If anyone were to clown on you for spending this much time in Evade, now's the time to ignore them. That whole sunk cost fallacy thing is a FARCE. You've spent years on this game, and you're just gotta stop at 900? Lame. No, I'm not instigating. Seriously, let's get to 1000 and crush this thing!

name: Level 1000
description:
REACH LEVEL 1000. 

Wow. Just wow. Level 1000. How many hours did it take? Genuinely curious here. 

I'd say I am speechless, but, well.. I'm typing this out rn. This is genuinely an achievement that should be placed alongside the greats, like the 86 Celtics or like the moon landing or something. You are EVADE. John Evade. Legally change your name RIGHT NOW.

I've got no doubt you've seen the game in all of it's form, cause it's been what, around for 3 years at the time of writing? Do you have the alpha tester badge? Got the Rockin' Stride emote? Hell, maybe I should give you your own cosmetic. Regardless, thanks for playing man. Like really, it's actually insane that you can squeeze so much content and fun out of this tiny lego game. Wish I could do that, but I tend to get bored fast lol. Seriously though, you got some skill. Keep doing whatever you like, if you're having fun, have at it! We're with you each step of the way (virtually).

- Oster, Beef

name: Soldats de ma Vieille Garde
description:
(Badge may require to rejoin, or to press P multiple times)
In order to get this badge, you must complete the following tasks:

1. Get a KDR of 10 or above.
2. Save 51 teammates from being grabbed by a zombie.
3. Stay alive for 35 rounds, without restarting, on Endless. It can start at any wave, just as long as you stay alive for 35 rounds in total.
4. Win 30 times or above in the campaign mode.
5. Acquire the following badges: Old Yeller, Cold Front, Explosive Retreat, and Deliverance from the Catacombs.

This unlocks the Old Guard Regiment under France.

Given to those whom sacrificed themselves for the betterment of their fellow soldier.
Obtaining this badge unlocks Chaplain and the Cross Necklace.

To unlock this achievement, you must:
- Save 150 teammates from being grabbed.
- Kill 75 runners pinning your teammate.
- Obtain the badge "Vos Enterrement".
- Heal teammates over 50 times (as Surgeon).

name: Royale Spring 2022!
description:
You Experienced An Eggcellent Egg Hunt In Royale High (2022)! 🥚 

Once the clouds part, all eyes turn to the skies yet again when a midnight thicket situates itself above Divinia Park! No weapons have ever been proven to work against the eldritch terror. Before the accident, bob was temporarily inactive. The only species left by the terror, roaming in anarchy, yet all united under the goal of finding a way to stop the beast before it's too late. The strongest group, calling themselves the "opposition", owned a small research facility, hidden deep underground. They would research, and do countless experiments to learn more about how bob works, his traits and most importantly; how to combat him. The opposition would conduct experiments to attempt replication of a docile version of bob. A version that they could control. Hundreds of experiments, yet none seem to be able to replicate the power of him. Hope is not lost, as a member returns to the facility with a sample of dark blob matter which they presume some lost tissue belonging to bob. They extract the DNA and experiment with it. name: Egging Over It
description:
There’s no feeling more intense than starting over. If you deleted your Clipped Wings badge the day before Rob Mastery, as I have, or if you left your Glove at home and you have to go back after spending an hour in the commute. If you won some Null Shards at the tournament, and then put all your winnings on Bob crate, but it came up as an uncommon. If you got your best shirt dry-cleaned before a Slap Royale match, but then immediately dropped an egg on it. If you won against Guide, and wanted to spare him, but your friend decides to end him instead, giving you a badge you already have. Starting over is harder than starting up.
If you’re not ready for that, like you’ve already had a bad day, then what you’re about to go through might be too much. Feel free to go away and come back. I’ll be here.

name: You're Hired!
description:
Welcome to Demonology Solutions! We're happy to have you here! Lucky for you, our employee mortality is at an all time low of 30%!

- Earn this badge by playing Demonology for the first time!

name: First Paycheck
description:
You're a natural! Congrats on your first successful job, here's to many more!

- Earn this badge by correctly identifying the ghost for the first time

name: Well, that ain't good
description:
They can't all be winners, and unfortunately you are now dead, but luckily our EMPLOYEE RESURRECTION PROGRAM(tm) can bring you back to life.

- Earn this badge by dying to the ghost during a job

name: Employee of the Month
description:
This reward is undoubtedly more special than any kind of jubilee, jamboree, etc etc. Congrats on being our Employee of the Month!

- Earn this badge by playing Demonology again at least a month after your first time!

name: That was scary...
description:
So, you survived your first ghost hunt. Now look, I know, you're absolutely terrified and are probably wanting to get out of your contract, but please refer to the fine print that explicitly outlines our "NO LEAVING AFTER SURVIVING YOUR FIRST GHOST HUNT" clause.

- Earn this badge by surviving your first ghost hunt on a job

name: Corporate Approval
description:
Speaking candidly here, most of our employees don't make it past their first job, so the fact that you've "successfully"? completed 10 has shocked all of us here at the corporate office. You certainly have our seal of approval, keep on doing.. whatever it is you're doing, because it's working.

- Earn this badge by identifying the ghost 10 times

name: Gold Star Sticker
description:
Look, we don't usually plan this far ahead, but, we found this gold star sticker on the backpack of one of our employee's kids, and after we heard you successfully completed your 25th job, we all decided you deserved it more.

- Earn this badge by identifying the ghost 25 times

name: Huge Bonus
description:
The director wasn't expecting to have to pay you more than 2 jobs worth of a salary, but since you've survived 50 jobs, we thought what the heck, we found this crisp 20 in a Walmart parking lot earlier today and now it's all yours buddy. 

- Earn this badge by identifying the ghost 50 times

name: Spiritualist
description:
We don't offer training for using the Umbra Board, but it seems like you're a savant with it and we are very lucky to have you here at Demonology Solutions, LLC.

- Earn this badge by communicating with the ghost through an Umbra Board

name: Self Reflection
description:
Regardless of whether or not you just wanted to stare at yourself in the mirror, you put it all on the line to help your team discover the ghost's whereabouts, and for that we applaud you.

- Earn this badge by using the Haunted Mirror to find the ghost room

name: Virtuoso
description:
We don't offer extra points for having a good music taste, but we do offer extra points for people who decide they want to take the risk of playing the creepy, haunted looking music box that was mysteriously and somewhat questionably placed in a location directly accessible to anyone entering the room.

- Earn this badge by using the Music Box to locate the ghost

name: Necromancer
description:
So let me get this straight, you saw a demonic symbol painted on the ground surrounded by blood red candles.. and your first thought was to light the candles? Crazy doesn't even BEGIN to describe that, but it helps our investigation so we're stuck between a rock and a hard place here.

- Earn this badge by using the Summoning Circle to summon the ghost

name: Clairvoyant
description:
You know how the song goes, 🎶 First you find the coin then you put the coin in the creepy looking Fortune Teller box- actually, you know, I don't think that's how any song goes. Well uh, still, that psychic animatronic seemed to help us along in our investigation, so way to go!

- Earn this badge by giving the Fortune Teller a coin to have your fortune read

name: Detective
description:
We always knew you had a little bit of that Sherlock Holmes spirit! By now, I'm sure you know that picking up any object that seems remotely cursed will plague you with the memories of some long dead inhuman entity, but you did it anyway. Therapy costs are not included in our Employee Compensation Plan, by the way.

- Earn this badge by using the Magnifying Glass to examine the ghost

name: The Way Back
description:
What was that place? We don't have that job listing on our itinerary... maybe all this ghost hunting is making us hallucinate?

- Earn this badge by finding The Way Back as part of The Hollow event
